description: Active Enyo NNUE improvement-run config. Use this as the reviewed candidate recipe.
goal: Test whether the Reckless-like Bullet architecture is practical at 384 hidden after 512 hidden improved speed but remained slower than normal Enyo NNUE.

success_condition: Bullet text conversion and BulletFormat validation pass
Enyo can load the selected 384-hidden quantised.bin checkpoint
Bullet parity and direct eval benchmark improves materially versus 512-hidden (~2.7M eval/s)
next_after_success: decide whether the Bullet path is worth further SIMD/integration work or needs a smaller/different architecture
